
Messages from the washer model WF45R6100AP/US with PCB DC92-02395A use a different message format.
It starts with 0x5A 0xA5 and has the same CRC at the end but it is 33 bytes in length on pin 1, as seen below.  The explanation of some of the known bytes is below.  This PCB uses baud rate 38400 for both pins.

If Tx is 0x01, then the xth lights from the bottom is lit.  T5 is hottest, T1 is coldest.
                       T5  T4  T3  T2  T1
temeprature 1: 5AA5C018001E005C0000000001E680FF00800000000000FF00000000002300A907
temperature 2: 5AA5C018001E005C0000010001E680FD00800000000000FF000000000023003C98
temperature 3: 5AA5C018001E005C0100010001E680ED00800000000000FF000000000023007A99
temperature 4: 5AA5C018001E015C0100010001ED80DB00800000000000FF000000000023006B95
temperature 5: 5AA5C018011E015C0118010601E680BF00800000000000FF000000000023009B4F
temperature 5: 5AA5C018011F015F0118015B818600CF00800000000000FF000000000023006364
temperature 1: 5AA5C018001F005F0018000681ED00EF00800000000000FF00000000002300B2FA
temperature 2: 5AA5C018001F005F0018010681ED00EF00800000000000FF00000000002300670C
temperature 3: 5AA5C018001F005F0118010681ED00EF00800000000000FF000000000023000207
temperature 4: 5AA5C018001F015F0118010681ED00EF00800000000000FF0000000000230047B3
temperature 5: 5AA5C018011F015F0118015B818600CF00800000000000FF000000000023006364

The bottom 5 bits of RR indicate which rinse cycle is selected.  bit 5 of byte 3 is the rinse 0, bit 4 is rinse 1, etc.
                     RR
      rinse 0: 5AA5C000001E005C0100010001CF806D00800000000000FF00000000002300DBEA
      rinse 1: 5AA5C010001E005C0100010001E680DB00800000000000FF00000000002300EBBD
      rinse 2: 5AA5C018001E005C0100010001E680ED00800000000000FF000000000023007A99
      rinse 3: 5AA5C01C001E005C0100010001ED80DB00800000000000FF00000000002300BC71
      rinse 4: 5AA5C01E001E005C0100010001ED80EF00800000000000FF000000000023001095
      rinse 5: 5AA5C01F001E005C0118010601BF80FD00800000000000FF00000000002300F00E

The bottom 5 bits of SC indicate which spin cycle is selected.  bit 5 of byte 5 is the spin 0, bit 4 is spin 1, etc.

The bottom 5 bits of SO indicate which soil level is selected.  bit 5 of byte 7 is the soil 0, bit 4 is soil 1, etc.
                             SO
       soil 1: 5AA5C010001F00500100010001CF80FF00800000000000FF0000000000230001AE
       soil 2: 5AA5C010001F00580100010001E680BF00800000000000FF00000000002300D13E
       soil 3: 5AA5C010001F005C0100010001E680CF00800000000000FF00000000002300E404
       soil 4: 5AA5C010001F005E0100010001E680FD00800000000000FF00000000002300AF75
       soil 5: 5AA5C010001F005F0118010601CF80EF00800000000000FF0000000000230051DB

Here are some samples of messages that include digits on the display and what those digits are.  m0 is the ones digit for the minutes.  m1 is the tens digit for the minutes.  The lower 7 bits are the segments a through g of the seven-segment display for that digit.  The segments a through g are in the normal order for a seven-segment display.

                                         m1  m0
            41 5AA5C018001E005C0000000001E6808600830000000000FF000000000023007433
            41 5AA5C018001E001C000000000166008600830000000000FF000000000023007249

            39 5AA5C018001E001C00000000014F00EF00820000000000FF000000000023008E34

            39 5AA5C018001E001C00000000014F00EF00820000000000FF000000000023008E34

            38 5AA5C018001E005C0000000001CF80FF00820000000000FF00000000002300AB44
